meta.name: image-to-code
meta.description: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计图转化为精确的网站代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从设计图生成高质量网页代码
copy.tagline_en: Convert design images into precise website code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-quality website code from design images

howto.what: 接到视觉为主的网页任务时,它会先自己生成设计图,再仔细分析图里的文字、配色、间距等细节,最后按图写前端代码。它倾向为每个区块单独出清晰大图,不把多区块挤成小图,也不裁剪旧图或做多层卡片嵌套。
howto.when: 当用户提出以视觉为主的网页任务时触发,例如做 hero 区块、落地页、网站改版等;纯技术修复或已有精确设计时则不强制。

say.text: 帮我做一个漂亮的落地页,先出设计图,再按图写代码
say.note: Claude 会先生成设计图并分析,再实现前端。

say.text: 我要重新设计产品页,第一个区块请单独出清晰大图
say.note: 让每个区块都有独立参考图,便于后续实现。

say.text: 做一版多区块的营销站点,避免卡片套卡片,别裁剪旧图
say.note: 要求新生成每个区块的设计图,而不是从旧图里裁。

howto.what_en: For visual web tasks, it first generates design images, analyzes them deeply, then codes the site to match. It favors large, per-section images over small compressed boards, fresh images over cropping old ones, and no nested-card UI.
howto.when_en: Triggers for visually-driven web tasks, e.g. hero section, landing page, site redesign. Does not force image-first for technical fixes or when a precise design system exists.

say_en.text: Build a beautiful landing page: design images first, then code.
say_en.note: It will generate and analyze design images first.

say_en.text: Redesign the product page; give each section its own clear image.
say_en.note: Each section gets a fresh standalone image.

say_en.text: Build a multi-section marketing site; avoid nested cards, no cropping.
say_en.note: New images are generated per section instead of cropping.
